en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about branding the livestock, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem with it except in their faces’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “
I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about marking the animals. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful except their faces.’”
